description: Auto-approve ONLY md-optimize's safe helper commands so a normal optimize run isn't interrupted. Unlike the other plugins' single-glob hooks, this delegates to approve_safe_commands.py, which shlex-parses the command and approves only: md_optimize_scope.py (read-only @import resolver, any subcommand) and md_optimize_history.py list/diff/snapshot (list/diff read-only; snapshot writes only into the backup store). The destructive subcommands — restore (overwrites your instructions file) and prune (deletes snapshots) — are deliberately NOT approved and still prompt, as does any command with shell chaining/redirection/substitution. Consent is granted at plugin install/trust time; delete this file to opt out (the skill still works, you'll just approve each helper call).
